about_the_game:
Welcome to SacriFrogos, where you’re in charge of a community of magical frogs trying to survive on a mysterious island. Your life (and theirs) revolves around one very needy bonfire.

Feed it the right mix of frogs and shiny things, and it rewards you with knowledge, relics, and resources to grow your village. Neglect it, and… well, it gets dark fast.

The game flows in two beats:

Chill & Build: gather resources, assign tasks, and watch your frogs learn new tricks. Build homes, brew potions, and slowly turn your little community into something almost respectable.

Ritual Time: when the bonfire calls, pick up your frogos and offerings and toss them before the hungry flames. It’s a short, frantic test of whether all that careful planning was actually worth it!

The Frogos

Every Frogo has three stats that decide what they’re good at:

  • Vitality: the muscle for chopping, forging, and foraging!

  • Faith: the spiritual spark that powers rituals and also the nursery.

  • Wisdom: the brainy side, learned by meditating at the spooky whispering well.

Train them, level up their skills, and hope they don’t get stage fright during the big ritual.

The Cycle

Sacrifice at the bonfire → unlock recipes at the Well → craft materials in the Forge → expand your village → raise more cute frogos → repeat.

Simple, right? Totally sustainable.

Key Features

  • A bonfire that constantly demands attention.

  • Magical frog villagers with unique strengths (and questionable judgment).

  • Resource gathering, potion brewing, and village expansion.

  • Real-time rituals that test your planning under pressure.

  • A cozy-froggy world with just a hint of ominous chanting.
